$$
\text{Books lost in the garage} = 46 - 35 = 11
$$

$$
\text{Total sick animals} = \text{Initial number} + (\text{Daily increase}) \times n
$$

Given:

- Initial number of sick animals = 82
- Daily increase in sick animals = 61
- Time period = 25 days

$$
\text{Total sick animals} = 82 + 61 \times 25
$$

$$

$$
